paite: Huan, hiaite Esau suante ahi uh (Esau Edom ahi).
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

paite: Esauin a jite Kanan gama nungakte laka a neih ahi; Hit mi Elon tanu Ada leh, Hiv mi Zibeon tanu, Ana Tanu Oholibamte ahi uh;
english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

paite: Ismael tanu, Nebaioth sanggamnu Basemath toh.
english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

paite: Huan, Ada in Eliphaz Esau a neihsaka; Basemath in Reuel a neia;
english: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

paite: Oholibam in Jeus leh Jalam leh Korah a neia; huaite Esau tapa, Kanan gama a neihte ahi uh.
english: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

paite: Huan, Esauin a jite leh, a tapate leh, a tanute leh, a in a mi tengteng leh, a gante leh, a sa tengteng leh, a sum tengteng, Kanan gama a muhte a paipih, a nau Jakob kianga kipan gamdang ah a pai mangta hi.
english: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

paite: A thilneihte uh a thupi lua a, a om khawm theikei uhi; a gante jiakin mikhual a a omna gam un lah a chinta kei hi.
english: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

paite: Huchiin, Esau tangah a omta: Esau tuh Edom ahi.
english: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

paite: Huan, hiaite Seir tang a Edom te suangpa Esau suante ahi uh:
english: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

paite: Hiaite Esau tapate minte ahi: Eliphaz Esau ji Ada tapa Reuel Esau ji Basemath ta.
english: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

paite: Huan, Eliphaz tapate Tamante Omarte, Zephote, Gatamte, Kenazte ahi uh.
english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

paite: Huan, Timna tuh Esau tapa Eliphaz mei ahia; aman Eliphaz Amalek a neihsaka: Huaite Esau ji Ada suante ahi uh.
english: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.

paite: Huan, hiaite Reuel tapate ahi uh; Nahath leh Zerahte, Samma leh Mizzate: huaite Esau ji Basemath suante ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

paite: Huan, hiaite Zibeon tanu Ana tanu Esau ji Oholibam tapate ahi uh: aman Esau Jeus leh Jalam leh Koran a neihsak hi.
english: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

paite: Hiaite Esau tapate laka heutute ahi uh: Esau ta chil Eliphaz tapate; heutu Temante, heutu Omarte, heutu Zephote, heutu Kenazte,
english: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

paite: Heutu Korah te, heutu Gatamte, heutu Amalek te: huaite Edom gam a Eliphaz akipana pawt heutute ahi uh; huaite Ada suante ahi uh.
english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.

paite: Huan, hiaite Esau tapa Reuel suante ahi uh; heutu Nahath te, heutu Zerahte, heutu Samma te, Heutu Mizzate: huaite Edom gam a Reuel akipana pawt heutute ahi uh; huaite Esau ji Basemath suante ahi uhi.
english: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

paite: Huan, hiaite Esau ji Oholibam suante ahi uh; heutu Jeus te, heutu Jalam te, heutu Korah te: huaite heutu Ana tanu Esau ji Oholibam suante ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

paite: Huaite Esau tapate ahi uh, huaite a lak ua heutute ahi uh: Esau tuh Edom ahi.
english: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

paite: Hiaite Hor mi Seir tapa huai gama omte ahi uh; Lotan te, Sobal te, Zibeon te, Ana te, Dison te, Ezer te, Disan te,
english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

paite: Huaite Edom gama Seir ta Horta laka kipana pawt heutute ahi uh.
english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

paite: Huan, Lotan tate Hor leh Hemam ahi uh. Lotan sanggamnu Timna ahi.
english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

paite: Huan, hiaite Sobal tate ahi uh; Alvan te, Manahath te, Ebalt e, Sepho te, Onam te.
english: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

paite: Huan, hiaite Zibeon tate ahi uh; Aia leh Ana: hiai Ana ahi, apa Zibeon sabengtungte a khah laia gamdaia tui sa khuk te mukhepa.
english: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

paite: Huan, hiaite Dison tate ahi uh; Dison leh Ana tanu Oholibam.
english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

paite: Hiaite Disan tate ahi uh; Uz leh Aran.
english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

paite: Hiaite Horte laka kipana pawt heutute ahi uh; heutu Lotan te, heutu Sobal te, heutu Zibeon te, heutu Ana te,
english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

paite: Heutu Dison te, heutu Ezer te, heutu Disan te: huaite Seir gama a heutu uh dan banga Horte laka kipana pawt a heutute ahi uh.
english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

paite: Hiaite, kumpipa kuamah in Israel suante tunga vai a hawm ma ua, Edom gama vaihawm kumpipate ahi uhi.
english: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

paite: Huan. Beor tapa Velin Edom gama vai a hawma; a khopi min Dinhaba ahi.
english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan: these are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

paite: Huan, Vel a si a, Bozra khua a mi Zerah tapa Jobab in a sikin vai a hawm ta.
english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

paite: Huan, Jobab a si a, Timante gam a mi Husam-in a sikin vai a hawm ta a.
english: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

paite: Huan, Husam a si a, Bedad tapa Hadad, tapa Hadad, Moab pawn a Midiante that pan, a sikin vai a hawma: a khopi min Avith ahi.
english: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

paite: Huan, Hadad a si a, Masrek mi Samla in a sikin vai a hawm.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

paite: Huan, Samla a si a, Luipi gei a Rebototh khua a mi Saula in a sikin vai a hawm hi.
english: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

paite: Huan, Saula, a si a, Akbor tapa Baal-hanana in a sikin vai a hawm ta hi.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

paite: Huan, Akbor tapa Baal-hanana a si a, Hada in a sikin vai a hawma: a khopi min Pau ahi; a ji min Hehetabel ahia, amah Mesahaba ta Matred tanu ahi.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

paite: Huan, hiaite a inkuan uh bang jel leh, a mun bang jel u leh a min bang jel Esau suan heutute min ahi; heutu Timna te, heutu Alva te, heutu Jetheth te;
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan, the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

paite: Heutu Oholibamte, heutu Elate, heutu Pinonte;
english: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

paite: Heutu Kenazte, heutu Temante, heutu Mibzarte;
english: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

paite: Heutu Magdiel te, heutu Iram te; huaite a gam neih uah a omna uh bang jelin Edom suan heutute ahi uh: huai Edom Edomte suangpa Esau ahi.
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

paite: Heutu Kenazte, heutu Temante, heutu Mibzarte;Heutu Magdiel te, heutu Iram te; huaite a gam neih uah a omna uh bang jelin Edom suan heutute ahi uh: huai Edom Edomte suangpa Esau ahi.
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

paite: Heutu Magdiel te, heutu Iram te; huaite a gam neih uah a omna uh bang jelin Edom suan heutute ahi uh: huai Edom Edomte suangpa Esau ahi.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
